'''Giran''' was a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]] who assisted [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] beast handler [[Malakili/Legends|Malakili]]. He hoped to snare a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] to pit against [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|Jabba's rancor]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], when the rancor was killed by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], Giran tried to comfort Malakili but couldn't hide his disappointment that the fight wouldn't happen. He was killed when Jabba's [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]], the ''[[Khetanna/Legends|Khetanna]]'', [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|exploded]] near the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]]. 

==Biography==
Giran was a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the<ref name="H2H" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]]<ref name="H2H" /> whose job was assisting<ref name="Galactic" /> [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Jabba">{{FactFile|38|JAB 1-4|Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] beast handler, [[Malakili/Legends|Malakili]], in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|his palace]] on the<ref name="Galactic" /> planet<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Galactic" /> He also served as a guard<ref name="LegacyCollection">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Legacy Collection|pack=Giran (Rancor Keeper)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TLCBD21Giran.asp}}</ref> and helped tend to [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|Jabba's rancor]] with Malakili<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Giran}}</ref> in the chamber below<ref name="LegacyCollection" /> Jabba's throne room.<ref name="ItWoSWT" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Giran was present in the palace when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] arrived to [[Rescue of Han Solo/Legends|rescue]] his friends from Jabba and was dropped into the chamber.<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

[[File:Malakili weeping.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Giran tried his best to comfort Malakili.]]
When Skywalker [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Rancor by dropping a gate on its skull, the Nikto rushed out to survey the damages.<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|60|Who's Who in Jabba's Palace}}</ref> Giran went up to Skywalker and throttled the Jedi before Malakili pulled the pair apart.<ref name="RotJ" /> He tried his best to comfort the crying Malakili but couldn't hide his disappointment that the rancor's death marked the end of his dream for the beast to fight a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]].<ref name="Who's Who" /> Giran and a [[Human/Legends|Human]] guard then escorted Skywalker from the pit.<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> Afterwards, Jabba sentenced Skywalker and his allies [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to death by being fed to the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] that lay in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]]<ref name="RotJ" /> in Tatooine's [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="ItWoSWT">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref> Giran rode on Jabba's [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]],<ref name="CSWE" /> The ''[[Khetanna/Legends|Khetanna]]'',<ref name="CS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref> when it ventured out into the execution spot.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|342|Giran}}</ref> At Carkoon, Skywalker and his allies were able to [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|fight back]] against Jabba's forces and destroy the sail barge,<ref name="RotJ" /> causing Giran's death.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Personality and traits==
Giran was loyal to Jabba and hoped to snare a krayt dragon and pit it against Jabba's rancor.<ref name="CCG" /> The Nikto had no affection for the rancor and only appreciated it for its primal strength and ferocity.<ref name="Galactic" /> He weighted 81 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]], stood at 1.8 [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="H2H" /> had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin, and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="H2H" />

==Skills and abilities==
Giran had slightly-above average speed,<ref name="Galactic" /> running at fifteen [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|per hour]].<ref name="H2H" /> The Nikto also had slightly-above average strength, average intelligence and fighting ability, and below average diplomacy. He was not [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]].<ref name="Galactic" />

==Equipment==
Giran utilized a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]].<ref name="LegacyCollection" /> When he was present in the palace<ref name="RotJ" /> in 4 ABY,<ref name="Date" /> Giran wore a brown [[Armor/Legends|chest plate]] over a light-colored [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]], brown wrist bracers, a baggy cream-colored waist sash with pouches, baggy black pants, and brown shoes. He also wore a hood, and his pants were secured at his calves with brown rope.<ref name="LegacyCollection" />

==Behind the scenes==
Giran first appeared in<ref name="RotJ" /> the [[1983]]<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="RotJ" /> The character was portrayed by [[Colin Hunt]].<ref name="Making">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>
